from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    p = list(accumulate(a, initial=0))

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = -1
    best_den = 1

    for j in range(k, n + 1):
        i = j - k
        pi = p[i]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            u = hull[-2]
            v = hull[-1]
            if (p[v] - p[u]) * (i - v) >= (pi - p[v]) * (v - u):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(i)

        pj = p[j]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            u = hull[head]
            v = hull[head + 1]
            if (pj - p[v]) * (v - u) >= (p[v] - p[u]) * (j - v):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        u = hull[head]
        num = pj - p[u]
        den = j - u
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
